newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 6.75/7.00 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 6.75/7.00 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 6.75/7.00 percent on Friday morning following ample supply.
Dealers said operators were surprised by the excess rupiah supply because liquidity had been tight at previous year-ends.
They said the ample supply was due to central bank injection of some 3.399 trillion rupiah into the money market on Friday.

One dealer said overnight money was at an early low of 6.25 percent. Bank Indonesia offered three-day SBIs at 6.5 percent, 6-7 day at 10.0 percent, 10-11 day at 10.5 percent, 12-19 day at 11.5 percent, 20-27 day at 11.75 percent and one-month at 12.25 percent.
Dealers said a similar liquidity condition was expected on 1996's last trading day next Monday. The market will be closed on December 31 and January 1 and will reopen on January 2.
The average overnight interbank rate on Thursday was 9.46 percent against 9.65 percent on Tuesday.
